rows.label: qst660101_msg0003
rows.name:
There's something unfamiliar
over there, mo...

rows.label: qst660101_msg0004
rows.name:
Could that be the mysterious light
Zuo-san mentioned...?

rows.label: qst660101_msg0005
rows.name:
It wasn't here the last time
we came, was it?

rows.label: qst660101_msg0007
rows.name: I'm curious what it could be, mo...

rows.label: qst660101_msg0008
rows.name:
If you're so curious, Tora, why
don't you go check it out?

rows.label: qst660101_msg0010
rows.name:
T-Tora will pass, mo. Tora always
leaves things like this to Boss, mo.

rows.label: qst660101_msg0012
rows.name:
Though I'd be lying if I said
I wasn't curious myself...

rows.label: qst660101_msg0013
rows.name:
Something as exciting as salvaging
might happen.

rows.label: qst660101_msg0014
rows.name: All right, Rex, we're counting on you!
